title: Perfect one-factorisation conjecture
statement: Perfect one-factorisation conjecture · Anton Kotzig, 1963. Every complete graph \(K_n\) of even order \(n\ge4\) has an edge partition into perfect matchings such that every pair of matchings forms a Hamilton cycle (current formulation and history).

counterexample.description: For a fixed even \(n\), a proof-producing exhaustive SAT search showing that no such partition exists is a finite refutation; the check recomputes the edge partition and Hamiltonicity clauses from \(K_n\).
